title: SDLC Repository Info v1
description: Closed JSON response envelope for discovering the nearest local Git repository from an arbitrary path.
$comment: Discovery walks the supplied path and its parents until a .git boundary is found. Metadata is local-only and read-only; origin may be null when no origin is configured.

schema.description: The canonical persisted repository-info response schema identifier.

fullPath.description: The absolute path supplied to repository discovery.

repositoryRoot.description: The absolute root directory of the nearest discovered Git repository.

gitDir.description: The absolute Git directory associated with the discovered repository.

isBare.description: Whether the discovered repository is bare.

origin.description: The local remote.origin.url value, or null when no origin is configured.
